table.retrieve:
Select 	Ic.Name, 
			Iclass.Name,
	OpeningQty = Sum( Case When Type = 'OP' Then A.Qty Else 0 End ) ,
	OpeningValue = Sum( Case When Type = 'OP' Then A.Value Else 0 End ),
	ClosingQty = Sum( Case When Type = 'CL' Then A.Qty Else 0 End ) ,
	ClosingValue = Sum( Case When Type = 'CL' Then A.Value Else 0 End ),
	PurQty = Sum( Case When Type = 'PV' Then A.Qty Else 0 End ),
	PurValue = Sum( Case When Type = 'PV' Then Case When :ai_pricetype = 1 Then A.Value Else ( A.Qty * Round(I.Saleprice / IsNull(I.PackUnits,1), 2 ) ) End Else 0 End ),
	PRQty = Sum( Case When Type = 'PR' Then A.Qty Else 0 End ),
	PRValue = Sum( Case When Type = 'PR' Then Case When :ai_pricetype = 1 Then A.Value Else ( A.Qty * Round(I.Saleprice / IsNull(I.PackUnits,1), 2 ) ) End Else 0 End ),
	SaleQty = Sum( Case When Type = 'SV' Then A.Qty Else 0 End ),
	SaleValue = Sum( Case When Type = 'SV' Then Case When :ai_pricetype = 1 Then A.Value Else ( A.Qty * Round(I.Saleprice / IsNull(I.PackUnits,1), 2 ) ) End Else 0 End ),
	SRQty = Sum( Case When Type = 'SR' Then A.Qty Else 0 End ),
	SRValue = Sum( Case When Type = 'SR' Then Case When :ai_pricetype = 1 Then A.Value Else ( A.Qty * Round(I.Saleprice / IsNull(I.PackUnits,1), 2 ) ) End Else 0 End ),
	OtherQty = Sum( Case When (Type = 'DS' OR Type = 'IV' OR Type = 'RV' OR Type = 'AI' OR Type = 'AD' ) Then A.Qty Else 0 End ),
	OtherValue = Sum( Case When (Type = 'DS' OR Type = 'IV' OR Type = 'RV' OR Type = 'AI' OR Type = 'AD' ) Then Case When :ai_pricetype = 1 Then A.Value Else ( A.Qty * Round(I.Saleprice / IsNull(I.PackUnits,1), 2 ) ) End  Else 0 End )

From	Item I, 
	ItemCategory Ic ,
	ItemClass IClass,
	(SELECT 
		type='OP', A.icode, 
		qty = sum(A.qty), 
		value=
			SUM(A.qty *
			CASE :ai_pricetype 
				WHEN 1 THEN Round(i.saleprice/ CASE i.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE i.packunits END, 2) 
				WHEN 2 THEN Round(i.purprice / CASE i.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE i.packunits END, 2) 
				WHEN 3 THEN i.avgprice 
			END)
	FROM	
		Item I,
		(SELECT pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
															when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
															when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
															else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
				pl.date < :ad_startdate and 
				pd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	pd.icode,
			qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
				pl.date < :ad_startdate and 
				pd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
		WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
				sl.date < :ad_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
				sl.date < :ad_startdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
		WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
				sl.date < :ad_startdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = sum(sd.qty)
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd,item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
				sl.date < :ad_startdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
				sl.date < :ad_startdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
				sl.date < :ad_startdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	d.icode,
			qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
				h.duesatisfydate < :ad_startdate and 
				d.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By d.icode) A
	WHERE A.ICode = I.ICode
	GROUP BY A.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		type='CL', A.icode, 
		qty = sum(A.qty), 
		value=
			SUM(A.qty *
			CASE :ai_pricetype 
				WHEN 1 THEN Round(i.saleprice/ CASE i.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE i.packunits END, 2) 
				WHEN 2 THEN Round(i.purprice / CASE i.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE i.packunits END, 2) 
				WHEN 3 THEN i.avgprice 
			END)
	FROM	
		Item I,
		(SELECT pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
															when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
															when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
															else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
				pl.date <= :ad_closingdate and 
				pd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	pd.icode,
			qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, item i
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
				pl.date <= :ad_closingdate and 
				pd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i
		WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
				sl.date <= :ad_closingdate AND sd.Due IS NULL and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
				sl.date <= :ad_closingdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item i
		WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
				sl.date <= :ad_closingdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty  = sum(sd.qty)
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd,item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
				sl.date <= :ad_closingdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
				sl.date <= :ad_closingdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode,
			qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item i
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
				sl.date <= :ad_closingdate and 
				sd.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	d.icode,
			qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item i
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
				h.duesatisfydate <= :ad_closingdate and 
				d.icode = i.icode and 
				i.icatcode in (:al_icatcode)
		Group By d.icode) A
	WHERE A.ICode = I.ICode
	GROUP BY A.Icode
	Union All
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(case pl.purcatcode when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
				else (pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty) end),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty)
			else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd, item
	WHERE	pl.date >= :ad_startdate and pl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN ( :al_icatcode ) 
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		value = sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd, Item
	WHERE	pl.date >= :ad_startdate and pl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
		pd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN ( :al_icatcode ) 
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd, Item
	WHERE	sl.date >= :ad_startdate and sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		/*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
		sd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN (:al_icatcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		icode = sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd, item
	WHERE	sl.date >= :ad_startdate and sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		sd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN (:al_icatcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	Union All
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = - sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		value = - sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d, item
	WHERE	h.duesatisfydate >= :ad_startdate AND h.duesatisfydate <= :ad_enddate AND
		h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
		d.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN (:al_icatcode)
	Group By d.icode
	Union All
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = - sum(sd.qty),
		value = - sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd, item
	WHERE	sl.date >= :ad_startdate and sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		/*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN (:al_icatcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	Select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd, item
	WHERE	sl.date >= :ad_startdate and sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		sd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN (:al_icatcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item
	WHERE	sl.date >= :ad_startdate and sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN (:al_icatcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = - sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = - sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd, item
	WHERE	sl.date >= :ad_startdate and sl.date <= :ad_enddate AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sd.icode = item.icode AND
		item.icatcode IN (:al_icatcode)
	Group By sd.icode
	) A

Where 	I.ICode = A.ICode And
	I.ICatCode = Ic.ICatCode And
	I.iccode = IClass.iccode And
	IClass.iccode In (:al_iccode)

Group By Ic.Name,IClass.Name
